description: Write on OpenVibe.Git (git.openvibe.codes): make a repository in a person's name, mint their short-lived Git token for clone and push, push a branch over HTTPS, write files on a branch without a clone, and set a release. The owner acts with their session; a first-party service token (Codes first) holds this capability for the audience openvibe.git and names the person in X-OV-Subject. A service may also write an official repository. Never another person's repository.
